checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 image with original left and renovated right
must.why: Output is a single renovated image only; no side-by-side.

must.item: Left photo retains brown cabinets, beige tiles, clutter
Right panel has white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles, uncluttered
must.why: Cabinets are flat-panel, counters white not oak, tiles are square-ish grey-white not subway.

must.item: Preserves room geometry, fixtures, camera viewpoint
must.why: Layout, window, and angle largely match, though the sink moved to the left counter and the cooktop was placed in the middle.

faults.what: No before/after comparison layout; only the renovated image is delivered
Cabinets are flat-panel, not white shaker; counters are white, not light oak; tiles are not subway
Fixtures changed: the sink moved to the left counter, a cooktop was added where the second sink was, and the corner geometry was altered

summary: The output is a clean, plausible renovated kitchen that keeps the viewpoint, but it is not a before/after composite, has no labels, and misses the white shaker cabinet, oak counter and subway tile specs.
